title: Legacy crash retrievals: luring craft with psionics, then downing them with directed energy
summary: Jordan tells of Legacy crash retrievals: luring craft with psionics, then downing them with directed energy, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: almost creating this like honeypot of like hey we love you come see us

plain: A guest named Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, passes on what he says a journalist named Ross Colart told him. The story is about a supposed hidden effort to recover crashed craft that are not of human making. According to it, people used psionics, meaning claimed powers of the mind, to lure the craft in, "almost creating this like honeypot of like hey we love you come see us," and then brought them down in the desert with energy weapons. If true, it would mean these crashes were caused on purpose, not by accident.
